0022600212.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (8-2, 4-1 at home, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) host the Boston Celtics (7-2, 5-0 at home, 2nd in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, 0.5 games back), with the 76ers' last ten at 8-2 but their most recent game a loss. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 regular season was split 2-2, while the 76ers won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-3, including a 109-100 win in Boston on May 2, 2026. For Philadelphia, Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (back fracture) are all out.
